message.content: According to their conversation on July 31, 2026, Hailey Johnson wants Li Hua to help gather feedback from the customers at the bakery for a bread-tasting event. Specifically, Hailey stated, "I'm planning a bread-tasting event at the bakery and would love your help gathering feedback from our customers." This event is scheduled to occur on Saturday from 10 am to 2 pm, and Hailey invited Li Hua to join and participate in collecting customer opinions on various bread options.
